translations.web: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
translations.bsb: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
translations.kjv: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
translations.asv: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
